title: Accessibility Gate
scope: Local deterministic verification of keyboard navigation, screen-reader semantics, text scaling, contrast preferences, and locale support on the canonical Windows repository.

budgets.metric: keyboard navigation: Tab/Shift+Tab traversal, shortcuts, Enter/Escape actions, keyboard reorder
budgets.unit: all interactive elements reachable via keyboard

budgets.metric: screen-reader semantics: structural labels and deterministic action announcements for interactive editor/control widgets
text scaling: UI validated at 1.3x and 2.0x text scale factor without overflow; narrow 390px layout tested
budgets.unit: no RenderFlex overflow at tested scales

budgets.metric: contrast/high-contrast: accessibility state and high-contrast preference model covered by platform UX tests
localization: English and Indonesian localization loading, delegate support, parity, and fallback tested
budgets.unit: en and id resources load without raw keys

baseline.profile: Widget tests at 1.3x and 2.0x text scale
en/id localization loading and delegate support

bottlenecks.impact: Widget-level semantics are tested; native OS screen-reader AT certification is not captured from cron.
bottlenecks.next_gate: Native AT certification on release-candidate hardware with human verification.

bottlenecks.impact: High-contrast state model is tested; physical-device contrast measurement is not captured from cron.
bottlenecks.next_gate: Hardware display contrast verification on release-candidate hardware.

findings.summary: No failure or overflow exception occurred in the executed accessibility matrix; keyboard navigation, screen-reader semantics, text scaling, contrast state, and locale loading are all verified at test level.

residual_risk_acceptance.acceptance: Native OS screen-reader AT certification and physical hardware contrast measurement deferred to release-candidate operational validation per accessibility_localization_verification.md.

limits: Native OS screen-reader AT certification is not captured from cron; screen-reader semantics are verified at widget/test level only.
Physical-device contrast measurement is not captured; high-contrast state model is tested via platform UX tests.
Platform-specific IME behavior and full locale translation review remain release follow-ups.
This decision is not a production accessibility certification; native GUI, hosted CI, signing, hardware, and public release remain UNVERIFIABLE.
